title: Model Trust Record
description: The signed, dated output of one Model Trust Gate run: one model, one use, one decision. Structured so a policy engine (e.g. OPA) can check its invariants at a deployment gate. The schema checks shape and consistency, not truth: whether a human should have written 'stop' instead of 'conditional' is beyond it.

version.description: Exact served version or file build/hash. 'latest' is not valid.

origin.description: cloud = provider's own model over an API; hosted-open-weight = open-lineage model served through a cloud provider (e.g. Qwen/Llama on Bedrock); downloaded-open-weight = weights you run yourself.

modified.description: Anything other than 'no' voids inherited behavioural evidence (re-test on the deployed artifact) and may flip your EU AI Act role to provider.

regulatory_floor.description: e.g. 'EU AI Act high-risk' or 'none'. A floor raises rigor regardless of the four drivers.

impact_assessment.description: ISO/IEC 42001 AI System Impact Assessment reference; plus EU AI Act FRIA reference where Art. 27 applies.

narrowed_use.description: Required (non-null) iff overall == 'restrict': the narrower use this record is valid for.

tier.description: Re-test tier for L3/L4 behavioural evidence; null (n/a) for L1/L2.

ref.description: Link to the ticket/report holding the evidence.

closes.description: The L3/L4 finding id this control closes, e.g. 'L4-F1'.

re_entry_log.description: Each N-1 fallback trigger that fired.

verified_removal_ref.description: Evidence the capability was actually removed (grant revoked, egress cut), not just re-described.

risk_transfer_ref.description: Risk Transfer Document reference handed to the system-level review.

risk_transfer_accepted.description: Must be true if risk_transfer_ref is set, or the deployment gate denies.

expires_date.description: Required machine date; the deployment gate denies once now > this.

expires_event.description: The human 'or event' trigger, e.g. 'next model-version bump'.

approved_by.description: Name + role. For R3/R4, must be independent of the team proposing the model.

incident_owner.description: Who notifies the provider/regulator on an incident, plus the deadline.

retention.description: How long the record is kept; at least the EU AI Act Art. 18 floor once provider status attaches.

record_status.description: A re-check produces a new record, not an edit.

record_signature.description: Signature over the record; required by the OPA policy at the gate.

allOf.description: A transferred risk must be accepted.
